review_scope_note: Appendix protocol material and PDF pages 22 onward were excluded by explicit user constraint.
prompt: Review the Paper 3 TMLR draft as a senior ML reviewer. Read only the supplied sanitized source, included tables, and visual-review PDF pages 1-21; inspect figures as needed. Do not open the original main.tex, original main.pdf, or omitted appendix material, especially any seed/protocol material. Return score, summary, ranked strengths and weaknesses, actionable major fixes, missing references, visual review, and Yes/Almost/No verdict. Judge claim calibration both ways; flag overclaims, narrative/repetition, self-containedness, notation and visual presentation. Do not propose new experiments or numerical changes; record new evidence requests as open items.
